title: 9GB site restore: a partial dump and three FTP shards
lede: An afternoon spent stitching a 9GB WordPress site back together from one truncated mysqldump and three half-broken FTP backups. Here is the restore log.
hero_alt: Overhead workbench shot of truncated mysqldump printout, three manila FTP folders, restore log, brass RESTORE plate, wax-sealed envelope.
